Great Food, Reasonable Prices!
Sep 2026 • Family
Really enjoyed our meal here. The food felt very authentic and the prices were really reasonable, especially for the quality and freshness.

The morning glory was delicious and cooked perfectly. The rice paper rolls were also really fresh and light. We especially liked the beef with betel leaf rice paper rolls, which had loads of flavour, and the duck rice paper rolls were another highlight.

Everything tasted fresh and well prepared, and it was great value for money. Definitely a place we’d happily come back to.

Thank you PH for your amazing service and demonstration of how to make the rice paper rolls!
